usedFor: ActiveCampaign holds your contacts and Streamtime holds your jobs, so “New Contact” can run “Create Job”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create Job” in Streamtime
bestTemplate.why: Each new contact becomes a Streamtime job, so creative work starts without anyone retyping the client.

watchOut: “New or Updated Contact” also fires on edits, so it can open a second job for the same person.
